task.description: The address of the task, for example @v1/nuucognition/task/<id>#ops. The task does not exist at the open: set it after Stage 1 with flint shard invocations set-input <id> task=<address>.

next.interactive: Create the task with flint shard task task-new and a body file of the note, place it, add its Ops address as an object with flint orbh objects add <address> --subscribe, set doing, and run flint shard task task-sync. Then set the input to the field ops of the output of task-new: flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>.
next.headless: Set the phase creating-task. Create the task with flint shard task task-new and a body file of the note from the prompt, place it, add its Ops address as an object with flint orbh objects add <address> --subscribe, set doing, and run flint shard task task-sync. Then set the input to the field ops of the output of task-new: flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>.

next.interactive: Do the work of {{task}}. Make each step that serves its intent a subtask in Strike. Follow the WIP commit rule of knw-task-commits, and keep each commit as <sha> (<repo>) for the result.
next.headless: Set the phase implementing. Do the work of {{task}}, and keep the progress current. Follow the WIP commit rule of knw-task-commits, and keep each commit as <sha> (<repo>) for the result. When blocked, use a deferred request.

steps.title: Result
steps.next: Write the result with ops task result {{task}} '<what the work gave>. Tests: <…>. Commits: <sha> (<repo>), …. Session: <ORBH_SESSION_ID>'. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}.

next.interactive: Give the person the summary of {{task}}. When the person wants a review, ask for it in Ops before the close: ops task review request {{task}} --note '<the summary, the commits, and what to check>'. On review_no_reviewer (a task of a team with no owner), run it again with --to me (the operator). The review comes next in a second session: flint shard invoke task review_task --input task={{task}}. Toward the review now: skip the step close, and close the invocation with --outcome done.
next.headless: Ask for the review in Ops: ops task review request {{task}} --note '<the summary, the commits, and what to check>' --json. On review_no_reviewer (a task of a team with no owner), run it again with --to me (the operator); do not guess another reviewer. Put the itemId and the reviewer in the evidence of this step and in the result, or the error code and the review command. Set the phase complete. Mark this step done, and close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the review_task command of the close in the result. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.

steps.title: Close
steps.next: When the person confirms, close the task with sk-task-close_task: ops task close {{task}}, then flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Keep the result: it names the commits. When the person wants the review first, skip this step with a reason, and close the invocation with --outcome done.

behaviours.say: The input task is empty: no task is recorded. Set it with flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>, or close the invocation with --outcome abandoned.

Before the return: write the result of {{task}}, with each commit as <sha> (<repo>) and the session. Then run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Ask for the review in Ops: ops task review request {{task}} --note '<…>' (on review_no_reviewer: --to me). Put the itemId of the request and the review_task command in the result.
